name: R095-trace-holder-foe-faints-on-spikes
why: Challenge 4. The opponent's Skarmory (482) lays Spikes and Roars; the player's Porygon2 (532, Trace) has Trace pending when the foe on the field faints on the Spikes (battle_util.c:1936-1958), so Trace waits with no Pokemon to copy (runPendingSwitchinEffects). The player plays random legal actions; the player's Porygon2 comes in as a replacement.
